allowedUse: Empirical resident-context joint observations; test birthplace-only assumptions
Candidate validation context for UK-raised diaspora background after cohort and reporting-category reconciliation
implementationDecision: Keep as contextual research; no runtime generator coefficients changed
limits: England/Wales residents are not the worldwide populations of their birth regions or NFL recruitment cohort
Birth categories include grouped regions; cannot distribute grouped counts across individual countries
All-age/all-sex observations lack athlete, upbringing, parentage and appearance channels
Reported eight-group ethnic classification is not a quantitative skin/hair/eye distribution and does not imply ability
ONS uses record swapping and cell-key perturbation; sums are aggregates of published perturbed cells, not independently certified national marginals
Does-not-apply categories retained; zero denominators produce null rather than invented shares
